description: This file contains the implementation of an immutable configuration object for JavaScript message mappers within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It defines the class ImmutableJavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration that implements configuration interface with methods for retrieving ID and various property maps, along with an internal Builder class for constructing instances.

classes.name: ImmutableJavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration
classes.description: Immutable implementation of JavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration, providing read-only access to message mapper configuration properties.

classes.name: ImmutableJavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration.Builder
classes.description: Mutable builder class for constructing ImmutableJavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration instances.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the message mapper configuration.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the properties map associated with the configuration.

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Returns the incoming conditions map for message filtering.

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Returns the outgoing conditions map for message filtering.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the delegationTarget object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on the delegationTarget.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the object including properties and conditions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds an immutable configuration instance from the builder.
